Nora: Quick fun poll: If you could keep only one snack forever in the office kitchen, what is it? Reply with snack + 1 word reason.
Sam: Dark chocolate  energy.
Diego: Potato chips  crunchy.
Priya: Hummus  healthy(ish).
Latasha: Cold brew  essential.
Mini-Bot: Snack stats: chocolate 1, chips 1, hummus 1, cold brew 1. Note: fridge space alert.
Nora: Tiebreaker: pick your backup snack.
Sam: Backup: almonds.
Diego: Backup: jerky.
Priya: Backup: fruit cups.
Latasha: Backup: oat bars.
Nora: Consensus: keep cold brew + rotate small snacks monthly. Office ops, can we make this a standing order? :coffee:
Mini-Bot: Suggestion posted to #office-ops: "Monthly small snack rotation + cold brew subscription".
Nora: Thanks team! Thread closed. :)
